Amelia Dimoldenberg added she had had two panic attacks and wanted to end the series ‘before I start resenting it’

Amelia Dimoldenberg, the host of Chicken Shop Date, has said she decided to end the popular YouTube series in order to have space to find love.

The comedian, 32, also revealed she had questioned the future of the interview series after suffering two panic attacks, saying she wanted to end it “before I start resenting it”.
